But JsonSchema abstract class may have different return type or method signature. However compile error says method does not override or implement a method from a supertype. So maybe method name is walk but abstract method is walk(ExecutionContext ctx, JsonNode node, JsonNode rootNode, String at, boolean isParent) returns Set<ValidationMessage>. That matches. But maybe JsonSchema defines walk with different generic type? Not sure. Could just remove @Override annotation from those methods, as they are not used. So delete @Override on walk, getTupleSchema.

In Java, method call thenReturn(mocks) where mocks is JsonSchema[] will be considered as a single argument of type JsonSchema[] which doesn't match JsonSchema.
